races.name: Knockcroghery Claiming Hurdle

runners_data.name: Getaway Charlie
runners_data.note: Trainer Timothy Doyle has gone 0/4 in the 14-day window and this 10yo hasn't run in 83 days, raising fitness questions; a natural front-runner by instinct, he is unlikely to get his preferred position with Rocky's Howya and Tullyveery Lad also wanting to race prominently, which further dampens his prospects.|

runners_data.name: Paul Collins
runners_data.note: Back extremely quickly after just 6 days, this 6yo has good-ground form but his best win came over 2m2f and this 3m trip is unproven — a prominent racer by nature, he is squeezed further back than ideal by the density of pace in this field, and his headgear (hood, p) adds a slight unknown.|

runners_data.name: Rocky's Howya
runners_data.note: The Tony Healy/7lb claimer combination lightens the weight, and this 10yo has two recent wins — one on Good, one on Heavy — giving him versatile credentials; headgear (visor, tv) has featured on winning occasions and he should secure a prominent pitch, making him one of the likelier position-getters in a crowded midfield.|

runners_data.name: Tullyveery Lad
runners_data.note: All 15 of his recorded runs have come on Good ground (2W5P) making him arguably the best-fitted horse in the field for today's surface; Darragh O'Keeffe is a strong booking and this 10yo is suited to 3m+ trips, with a blinkers fitment that sharpens his jumping focus — well-placed to track the leader if he gets his natural position.|

runners_data.name: Howdoyalikeherhome
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed front-runner, Gordon Elliott's 7yo has a clear tactical edge with Gilligan able to dictate; ran just 6 days ago which is worth monitoring for residual fatigue, and his STYLE_FIT tag (0.92) serves as a mild caution — he is racing out of his most comfortable mode by leading throughout rather than racing with cover, but at this level and trip, controlling the race may suit.|

runners_data.name: Bocelli's Voice
runners_data.note: McLoughlin's 10yo is 0/12 at similar going, and a genuine hold-up horse redistributed into the midfield map here; the 7lb claimer Alix Balfe adds inexperience at the sharp end, and without strong finishing form over this distance (all hist runs over 2m), generating momentum from the rear seems a stretch.|

runners_data.name: Garnetot
runners_data.note: The youngest in the field at 5yo and with only 9 runs behind him, Elliott's lightly-raced type has a mixed record (0W1P similar going) but showed a decent second at 2m on Good as recently as early 2025 — if the longer 3m test brings out improvement and Paddy Cleary (7lb claim) times the run correctly from the rear, he is not without interest at big odds.|

runners_data.name: Live My Dream
runners_data.note: Five-year-old with a modest profile — 0 wins, 0 places on similar going from 5 runs — stepping up markedly to 3m having shown nothing beyond 2m3f in recent history; Josh Williamson's 5lb claim helps on weight but the combination of trip doubt, poor recent form (07P7P-), and genuine hold-up style in a race lacking the strong pace to set up a closer makes this a very difficult proposition.|

races.paceDynamic: Howdoyalikeherhome is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 3m Good-ground claiming hurdle at Roscommon, and with no natural challenger for the lead, Danny Gilligan can dictate terms at whatever tempo suits, setting a controlled, sustainable gallop over the extended trip. Behind the leader, Rocky's Howya, Tullyveery Lad, and Getaway Charlie are all genuine prominent racers, but there are simply too many of them to all occupy the positions they prefer — at least one or two will be forced to race further back than ideal, creating a compressed midfield. Paul Collins, returning quickly after just 6 days, and Bocelli's Voice are similarly squeezed, with the hold-up contingent of Garnetot and Live My Dream likely to find themselves genuinely towards the rear rather than benefiting from a contested pace to close into. This race shape strongly favours horses who can travel prominently behind Howdoyalikeherhome and mount a sustained challenge from 2 out, rewarding stamina and fluency at the obstacles over a pure finishing kick — prominent types with genuine 3m credentials are best placed, while true hold-up horses face an uphill task if the pace is controlled and the race lacks the end-to-end gallop needed to set up a late run. The field holds more prominent types than can realistically secure their natural position, and Rocky's Howya and Tullyveery Lad — both with strong good-ground form and proven at the trip — are the most likely to actually command those coveted spots just off the lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Howdoyalikeherhome Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Howdoyalikeherhome bowls along unchallenged and the race is run at a measured, front-runner-friendly tempo from start to finish.
scenarios.body: Gilligan settles Howdoyalikeherhome in front at a comfortable pace, the field strings out behind him, and the leader's jumping fluency becomes a decisive weapon on the long 3m trip. Prominent types who travel within striking range going to the last are the main beneficiaries, but they must be good enough to peg back a fresh, well-placed leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If Rocky's Howya or Tullyveery Lad track the leader throughout and outstay Howdoyalikeherhome in the straight.
scenarios.body: Both horses have proven form on Good ground at this sort of trip, and if Howdoyalikeherhome's recent run (6 days ago) leaves a mark late on, one of these prominent stalkers can collide going to the last and assert. Tullyveery Lad's extensive Good-ground history (15 runs, 2W5P) and Darragh O'Keeffe's experience make this a credible alternative shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Redistribution Creates Scrappy Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the surplus of prominent types create friction early, lifting the tempo beyond what Howdoyalikeherhome's connections intend.
scenarios.body: Paul Collins (back in just 6 days), Getaway Charlie, and Rocky's Howya all wanting prominent ground could force a sharper pace in the middle stages, raising the chance that the closers — Garnetot in particular given his youth (5yo) — find more in the straight than expected. However this scenario is discounted because several of the would-be closers are redistributed prominent types, not natural hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong enough throughout to collapse the field and leave the race open for Live My Dream or Bocelli's Voice sweeping from the rear.
scenarios.body: This outcome requires a near-perfect storm of a hot gallop set by multiple prominent types that burns them all out — unlikely given the lone front-runner dynamic — and true hold-up horses that can find the finishing gears over 3m on Good ground, which neither Live My Dream (0W0P on similar) nor Bocelli's Voice (0W1P similar) have convincingly demonstrated. The probability here is minimal.

watchPoints.text: Rocky's Howya and Tullyveery Lad will both be intent on racing prominently — watch the early stages to see which one secures the position just off Howdoyalikeherhome, as the horse who gets that slot rather than being crowded out is materially better placed over 3m.

Paul Collins returning after just 6 days and Getaway Charlie after 83 days represent opposite freshness risks — watch both in the paddock and early in the race for signs of either ring-rustiness (Getaway Charlie) or residual fatigue (Paul Collins).

Howdoyalikeherhome also ran just 6 days ago — if he shows any sign of blowing hard or making jumping errors mid-race that he wouldn't normally make, his lead could evaporate quickly in the final mile.

Garnetot is the only 5yo in a field of mostly 10yos — watch whether his jumping holds up under the pressure of a 3m trip, as young horses can be vulnerable to errors late on when stamina is tested for the first time at this distance.

The surplus of prominent-style horses means the early order will likely be untidy — watch for crowding or interference on the first circuit that could unsettle runners like Bocelli's Voice or Live My Dream who are already struggling against the race shape.

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Acheron
runners_data.note: John Joseph Hanlon runner whose best recent form shows placed efforts when getting a strong gallop to aim at; his natural hold-up style is compromised here by the field's composition, leaving him mapped to midfield rather than his preferred rear position, which dulls his finishing-kick chance.|

runners_data.name: Casper Charlie
runners_data.note: Has only one hurdles run on record, a tailing-off effort, and the fades-in-finish flag is a concern over this stamina-testing 2m4½f; Una Corcoran yard has had no runners in the past fortnight and the layoff of 65 days adds uncertainty.|

runners_data.name: Cooladdi
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with two places from five similar-going starts, handles Good ground well and has a 2m4f trip placing on his card; the Eoghan Finegan 7lb claim helps offset a modest OR of 102 and he should track Frankie's Freebie naturally from the front.|

runners_data.name: Frankie's Freebie
runners_data.note: The race's sole confirmed leader; two wins and a string of placed efforts in front-running roles, handles Good ground adequately with two from seven in similar conditions; Harry Sexton's 4lb claim is a further asset and uncontested lead over 2m4½f suits this profile.|

runners_data.name: Fuusland
runners_data.note: Gordon Elliott-trained debutant hurdler with no going or hurdles form on record; the unknown quantity cuts both ways — Elliott's yard regularly land these with a well-prepared youngster, but the 0/21 trainer 14-day stat and unknown going make him a speculative proposition.|

runners_data.name: Go To The Moon
runners_data.note: Only one hurdles run showing a distant finish on Good ground, and the fades-in-finish profile is ominous over a trip that demands stamina; the 55-day absence adds to the profile of a horse who may need the run.|

runners_data.name: Imarajan
runners_data.note: Paddy Cody 4lb claimer aboard a horse with eight placed efforts from twelve starts on similar going — a model of consistency; naturally prominent, should travel smoothly into contention tracking the leader and his placing record over 2m-plus on Good suits this race shape precisely.|

runners_data.name: Killowen House
runners_data.note: Had a placed effort over 3m on Good and pulled up once in six runs; the Paul John Gilligan yard has been 1/13 in the last fortnight which is marginally active, and a style tag of Unknown makes positioning unpredictable, but the Good-ground placed form over distance is relevant.|

runners_data.name: Little Big John
runners_data.note: Three runs including a 6th on Good over 2m3f; heading-gear flag (hood) and a style tag of Unknown make him hard to place tactically; the Maike Magnussen trainer has had minimal runners and this looks a confidence-run more than a winning proposition.|

runners_data.name: Blue Nude
runners_data.note: P J Rothwell's 4-year-old has one run — a last-of-16 finish on Good — and the fades-in-finish tag reinforces that reading; the trainer has been 1/16 in the last fortnight and the horse's genuine hold-up inclinations are squeezed by the crowded rear of this field, placing him in midfield against his nature.|

runners_data.name: Take The Free
runners_data.note: E Bolger's 4-year-old has a 2nd on Soft to his name and some placed hurdles form; a true hold-up type whose best chance depends on a strong pace that doesn't exist here, and with his natural position congested at the back, the mapped midfield role reduces his effectiveness materially.|

runners_data.name: Lilac Lady
runners_data.note: Mark McNiff runner with four placing efforts from fifteen similar-going starts — consistent but not a winner; a genuine hold-up type squeezed into midfield by the race shape, though her disciplined jumping record (tongue tie) and familiarity with Good ground mean she won't be disgraced.|

runners_data.name: Midnight Musical
runners_data.note: Ran only three days ago, a red flag for bounce risk; recent form of 8th and 5th on Good is unimpressive, the fades-in-finish note is consistent with that record, and Anthony McCann's yard has had just four runners in the past fortnight.|

runners_data.name: Online Order
runners_data.note: Single career run, a 7th on Soft over 2m; Liam Cusack's stable has been quiet and the lack of any Good-ground or hurdles-trip form means this is an unknown quantity whose hold-up style will be hard to exploit behind a single slow pace-setter.|

runners_data.name: Sea Feliz
runners_data.note: W P Mullins debutant hurdler with no exposed form — the classic wildcard; the yard has been 1/12 in the last fortnight and Mullins regularly debuts well-schooled types at provincial tracks; Anna McGuinness claiming aboard, and going listed as Unknown, but the trainer's record demands respect.|

races.paceDynamic: Frankie's Freebie is the only confirmed front-runner in this 15-runner maiden hurdle over 2m4½f on Good ground at Roscommon, and with no natural rival for the lead, Harry Sexton's mount can dictate a measured, uncontested gallop from the front. The pace is unlikely to be strong — a lone leader over this trip on Good ground typically sets a rhythm that suits the race developing into a test of jumping and stamina from the home turn rather than a truly run-out affair. Prominent racers who can track the leader without expending excess energy early, such as Cooladdi and Imarajan, are best placed to exploit the moderate tempo and kick from close to the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent-to-lead types: the absence of genuine pace pressure means those racing close to Frankie's Freebie need never panic, while horses trying to make ground from off the pace face a stiff ask if the tempo never truly quickens. The field holds more hold-up types than can realistically settle deep — Acheron, Blue Nude, Take The Free, and Lilac Lady are all true closers who are mapped to midfield and are unlikely to get the patient, pace-dependent run that suits them, making it harder for that profile to land the prize.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Frankie's Freebie leads from the front, sets a comfortable tempo, and no rival applies sustained pressure from the second-last.
scenarios.body: Frankie's Freebie controls every yard of the race, jumping fluently and quickening away from the final hurdle before rivals can close the gap; the prominent trackers Cooladdi and Imarajan are best positioned to chase but lack the class to reel in an unchallenged leader on Good ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Closers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Frankie's Freebie sets a modest early tempo and ties up approaching the final hurdle, allowing prominent-tracking types to swoop past.
scenarios.body: A runner like Imarajan or Cooladdi, having travelled smoothly in second or third throughout, picks up decisively at the second-last to collar the leader on the run-in; their consistent form figures at this trip and going profile them as the primary beneficiaries of this shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Held-Up Type Gets Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy scramble with interference or a faller causing gaps that allow a patient hold-up runner to thread through late.
scenarios.body: One of the redistributed hold-up types — most plausibly Take The Free, who has shown a placed effort, or Lilac Lady with her consistent placed record in similar going — benefits from a fortuitous split and finishes fastest of all; this scenario is discounted because none of the true closers can get their natural position in this race shape.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Lands Gamble
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly raced unknowns — Fuusland, Sea Feliz, or Killowen House — turns out to be a well-schooled type with unexposed ability that embarrasses the more exposed runners.
scenarios.body: Sea Feliz (W P Mullins, debut hurdler) or Fuusland (Gordon Elliott, unknown going) could be sitting on a rating well above what the field offers, winning without the race shape mattering; this is a low-probability event given the lack of any exposed form to model, but the presence of two major yard debutants keeps it alive.

watchPoints.text: Frankie's Freebie jumps the first two hurdles clean or not — if Harry Sexton has his mount settled and jumping fluently from the front, the uncontested lead scenario is firmly on track; a stumble or mistake early could invite the prominent pack to take over.

Imarajan's position jumping the third-last is the key tracking data point — if Paddy Cody has him in second or third at that stage on a loose rein, the prominent-closer scenario is live; if he's already niggled at, his chance is gone.

Sea Feliz and Fuusland are both debutant hurdlers from Mullins and Elliott respectively — watch the market for either runner drifting or being supported into the final hour, as late money from powerful yards on unknown types often signals intent.

Midnight Musical ran just three days ago — watch whether she travels with any fluency in the early stages or shows signs of a quick-turnaround bounce, which would remove one of the more prominent-rated OR horses from contention.

The redistribution of Acheron, Blue Nude, Take The Free, and Lilac Lady into midfield means a cluster of hold-up types are racing bunched together from flag-fall — watch for traffic issues and interference at the fourth-last hurdle where this group is most likely to compress.

races.name: Shanagher Hearing Maiden Hurdle (Div 1)

runners_data.name: Firebrand
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid recent form (2nd last time out on good ground), wears a tongue-tie, and has placed five times in similar conditions — Daniel King partners a horse who should travel fluidly just off Game Point.|

runners_data.name: Cocofred
runners_data.note: Henry De Bromhead's 5yo has only three hurdle runs and limited form to go on; a genuine hold-up horse by nature, the large field means it is unlikely to get its preferred rearward berth, which materially dents its prospects in a pace-controlled race.|

runners_data.name: Glengarriff
runners_data.note: Flags repeatedly for fading in the finish and has posted a string of poor hurdles results (18th, 13th, 19th in recent starts); a 5yo apprentice-ridden at 158lbs in a maiden with this profile offers little appeal.|

runners_data.name: Lengaruka
runners_data.note: Complete unknown — no form string or last-run data available; Mrs Lorna Fowler has 0 wins from 3 runners in 14 days and the horse's style is unclassifiable, making it a pure speculation.|

runners_data.name: Luker's Tipple
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner for Gavin Cromwell with six places in form (including 2nd and 3rd on good ground); Conor Stone-Walsh keeps the ride and the horse's record on this going (8/15 runs) supports a bold showing.|

runners_data.name: Ozark's Walk
runners_data.note: Fades in the finish flag undermines its claims; the 111-day absence is a significant concern, and its best recent effort (2nd, 4th) came over slightly longer trips — the hold-up style also leaves it reliant on a stronger pace than Game Point is likely to set.|

runners_data.name: Sunny Dude
runners_data.note: Consistent fader who has managed only a 6th at best in recent starts; the stable has 0/2 in the past 14 days and its hurdles form on good ground (12th last time) gives little reason for confidence.|

runners_data.name: Tellyouwhat
runners_data.note: Pulled up on its only hurdles start on good ground; the unknown style, 5yo status, and Calum Hogan (claimer) combine to make this a very risky proposition despite Edward Mitchell's light campaign.|

runners_data.name: Finjimk
runners_data.note: Fell and pulled up before posting a 7th on its only hurdles start on good ground; Peter John Flood has 0/2 in 14 days and the horse's inconsistency at this stage of its career is a concern.|

runners_data.name: Game Point
runners_data.note: The confirmed pace-setter ridden by Jack Kennedy — wears headgear and has placed 5 times on good ground including 2nd and 3rd; listed as Prominent with a style-fit flag suggesting it may be slightly ahead of its natural role, but Kennedy's hands will keep it organised.|

runners_data.name: Astelia
runners_data.note: Peter Fahey's 7yo has placed seven times including three 2nd-place finishes on good-to-good ground; a reliable prominent racer who consistently finds the frame — 41 days since last run is not a barrier given the consistency of recent form.|

runners_data.name: How's Ellie
runners_data.note: Mullins-trained 5yo returning from 223 days off; both hurdles runs produced 5ths and the long layoff introduces a significant fitness question — hold-up style means it needs a stronger gallop than this race is likely to produce.|

runners_data.name: Poetic Parable
runners_data.note: No form data or last-run information available; Ross O'Sullivan has 0/10 in the past 14 days and the horse is unclassified on style, making any assessment speculative.|

runners_data.name: Dadou Part Two
runners_data.note: Rothwell's 4yo has faded on its only hurdles run (11th on good ground) and carries a fades-in-finish concern; a natural hold-up horse that is pushed into a midfield mapping by field size — its structural position makes it less likely to produce a career-best in this shape.|

runners_data.name: Pretty Wild
runners_data.note: Debutant trained by E. Bolger with Harry Cobden, a high-class jump jockey, booked for the ride — the combination is the strongest unknown in the race; no history to assess style or going preference, but the Cobden booking demands respect.|

races.paceDynamic: Game Point is the confirmed front-runner here and, with Jack Kennedy aboard, will look to establish a clear lead from the outset and control tempo on good ground over 2m. With 15 runners but only one genuine pace-setter, the gallop is likely to be sustainable rather than scorching — a measured lead that keeps rivals honest without burning them off. Prominent racers Firebrand, Luker's Tipple, and Astelia will slot in behind Game Point, creating a compact early order that rewards those travelling smoothly in the first half of the race. This shape strongly favours prominent-to-midfield runners who can sit a length or two off the pace and quicken over the final two hurdles, rather than true hold-up horses needing a strong pace to close into. The field contains more hold-up types than the map can accommodate at the rear — Dadou Part Two and Cocofred are genuine hold-up horses pushed into the midfield map position because they are unlikely to secure their natural position against this many prominent runners; both face a structural disadvantage in what shapes up as a pace-controlled affair.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Lead, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Game Point dictates a measured tempo unchallenged and the race is won from the front or just off it.
scenarios.body: Game Point sets a sustainable gallop and the race lacks the pace to stretch the field, meaning those travelling prominently in his wake have first run jumping the last; Firebrand, Luker's Tipple, and Astelia are ideally placed to pounce having conserved energy throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Midfield Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Game Point's lead is too slow and the race bunches, creating a messy scramble home.
scenarios.body: A slow pace compresses the field into a convoy, nullifying hold-up runners and rewarding any midfield horse with a clear run to the final hurdle; horses like Luker's Tipple and Firebrand, handy and balanced, benefit most from the resulting sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Game Point's pace is quicker than expected and the front group ties up in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: A stronger early tempo would leave the prominent brigade vulnerable to late runners finishing off their races; How's Ellie and Cocofred theoretically profile for this shape, though both are mapped out of their deepest hold-up position and their ability to close is structurally compromised.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Debutant Lands Blow
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly raced or unraced runners — Pretty Wild, Poetic Parable, or Lengaruka — arrives with a significant upgrade on debut.
scenarios.body: An unexposed horse with natural ability can land the race before rivals have formed a reliable read on their ceiling; Harry Cobden's association with Pretty Wild (E. Bolger-trained) gives that runner the strongest case for a debut strike in this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Game Point's early sectionals will set the entire pace picture — if Jack Kennedy allows it to stride out freely without pressure, the race will almost certainly be won from the front or just off it, making it essential to track.

Pretty Wild (Harry Cobden, E. Bolger) arrives without any public form — a Bolger debutant with a top jumps jockey is a classic dark-horse flag in an Irish maiden hurdle and should be monitored in the market.

Astelia's record of seven places without a win raises the persistent question of whether it will finally convert — if it travels prominently and jumps well, the lack of a win becomes the only outstanding query going to the last.

The redistribution of Dadou Part Two and Cocofred into midfield mapping overstates their likely tactical position — both will struggle to get their preferred ground at the rear in a 15-runner field, and their finishing kicks should be treated with scepticism if the pace is modest.

The cluster of hold-up types flagged as faders — Glengarriff, Ozark's Walk, Sunny Dude — all risk being stranded if Game Point sets only a modest tempo, as they require a stronger gallop to get competitive.
